en.meta.title: Xenon 5.0: new look, desktop widgets, FPS overlay and Bit
en.meta.desc: Xenon 5.0 brings the Liquid Glass look, widgets on your main screen, FPS and Instant Replay in one app, and Bit, an AI that builds widgets. Free, no account.
en.ld.name: What's new in Xenon 5.0
en.ld.desc: Xenon 5.0 brings the Liquid Glass look, widgets on your main screen, FPS and Instant Replay in one app, and Bit, an AI that builds widgets. Free, no account.
en.v5.lede: A new look, widgets on the screen you already have, FPS and Instant Replay in the same app, and Bit, an AI that builds widgets for you.
en.v5.free: Free, no account. Windows 10 and 11, with macOS and Linux in beta.
en.v5.edge.alt: The Xenon dashboard in Liquid Glass on a 2560 × 720 Xeneon Edge: music, weather, the PC's sensors, a video and game performance
en.v5.edge.cap: Liquid Glass, the new look. After the update your old look stays saved, one tap brings it back.
en.v5.when.h: You choose when you see it
en.v5.main.p: Widgets on the desktop or over any app, with no second monitor.
en.v5.main.alt: Calendar, music and system widgets appearing on a desktop
en.v5.when.p: Each widget shows always, on the desktop, in game or over one app. Drag it on the map of your screens, even to another monitor.
en.v5.when.alt: A widget dragged across the map of three screens
en.v5.game.p: FPS, 1% lows and frame time over the game you are playing, with CPU, GPU, ping and packet loss. Lows and frame time are on Windows, FPS on Linux too.
en.v5.game.alt: FPS, CPU, GPU, RAM, ping and packet loss on one line over a football game, with the game blurred
en.v5.cap.p: Xenon captures the screen by itself, on any graphics card, and saves the last seconds of what you just played.
en.v5.cap.alt: A chat with Bit: asked to save the last 42 seconds, Bit says the clip is on the Desktop
en.v5.bit.p: Ask for a widget, a theme or a scene and Bit builds it. It runs on Sparks, Xenon's own credits, so you need no API key.
en.v5.bit.alt: A chat with Bit: asked for a widget that counts down to a holiday, Bit puts it on the screen
en.v5.maker.p: Build widgets, themes and scenes on xenon-app.com without code. Free to try. Supporters save, export and install.
en.v5.maker.alt: Xenon Maker editing a widget that lists the next events
en.v5.pass.p: 5 USD a month opens the supporter drops and adds 300 Sparks every month. Try the drops free for 7 days.
en.v5.pass.alt: Four supporter drops: a Halloween house, a smart home panel, a CPU gauge and a lake scene
en.v5.rest.1: Widgets and pages that appear only when you need them
en.v5.rest.2: Deck keys on your screen, and more kinds of keys
en.v5.rest.3: The battery of your wireless mouse, keyboard and earbuds
en.v5.rest.4: Set each fan and LED of your lights
en.v5.rest.5: Chat with Bit from the search bar
en.v5.rest.6: Your Ambient scene as wallpaper or screensaver
en.v5.rest.7: Bit asks when it is not sure
en.v5.rest.8: A new Store, and Settings at full screen
en.v5.rest.p: On Mac and Linux, widgets on the screen and capture are in beta. Every change, version by version, is in the release notes.
en.v5.dl.lede: Free, no account, and it updates itself after this.
en.v5.dl.win.req: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Installs the app and starts it at login.
en.v5.dl.store.alt: Get Xenon from the Microsoft Store
en.v5.dl.mac.req: macOS 11 or later. Apple Silicon and Intel in one file.
en.v5.dl.linux.req: Any x86_64 desktop. Also as .deb and .rpm.
